name: 20740 · College Park, MD
findings: ZIP 20740 (College Park) has 172 nonprofit organizations. 92 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 80 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20740 (College Park) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
